items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Now we got one guy around New York, who was the best around right now, Bernard Anderson.

ctx.x: Well, they just play solos and things like that. Yeah, most of them want to play solos and I can't stand those lectures. You see now, Johnny, Johnny Sincero is the one we got left. Now we got one guy around New York, who was the best around right now, Bernard Anderson.
Yeah, I was going to ask that.
